about_the_game:
A robot awakens, finding itself in a digital wasteland ravaged by a virus. POOL is a sci-fi adventure puzzle game that combines exploration, puzzles, and storytelling to gradually unveil the secrets behind these ruins.

A Solitary and Enigmatic Journey

One robot, one desolate and shattered world. No clamor of human voices, only the low hum of the wind blowing through the ruins and the faint buzz from a distant past. You are the only “life” in this wasteland, bearing a mission: to piece together the truth of this world’s collapse.

A Forgotten World

You will navigate through crumbling buildings and rusted machinery, using a neural data cable to decrypt the “Data Fragments” scattered throughout. These fragments are like remnants of time—sometimes the last glimmer of human hope, sometimes unsettling whispers of despair. Even stranger are the “Data Echoes”—emotional remnants of the departed. These echoes seep into your core, blurring the line between memory and illusion. Can you stay sane, or will this wasteland consume you?

A Battle of Survival and Strategy

Faced with threats lurking in the shadows, you must remain ever vigilant. Yet even so, every step is an adventure, every choice a matter of life or death. Will you press forward, or choose to retreat? This wasteland watches you—it never forgives mistakes.

Collecting Parts and Chips to Strengthen Yourself

Using the Neural Data Cable to Infiltrate Devices

Rich Storyline

Collectible “Data Echoes”

A Labor of One

This is a dream crafted single-handedly by an independent developer with sweat and passion. From every line of code to every design detail, it’s infused with heart and perseverance. This is more than a game—it’s a growing story—and you can be a part of it. Join our community, shape this world with me, and explore profound questions about humanity and the future: when machines rule all, are we still “us”?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit OS required)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Quad Q6600 @ 2.4 GHz, AMD FX 8120 @ 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 630 / 650m, AMD Radeon HD6570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card
